rows: Several power poles were blown down by thunderstorm winds near El Oso.
A thunderstorm produced wind gusts estimated at 50 mph which knocked down large tree limbs in Panna Maria and Kenedy.

A thunderstorm produced wind gusts estimated at 60 mph which caused damage in and around Karnes City and Kenedy. The Karnes County emergency manager reported trees toppled over and roofs blown off carports.
A small weak EF0 tornado formed along the leading edge of a large cluster of storms in Runge, crossing a few neighborhood streets. Most damage was confined to house roofs, outbuildings, and trees.

A thunderstorm produced wind gusts estimated at 45 mph that knocked down several tree limbs southwest and west of Kenedy. This storm also produced half inch hail. This storm also knocked down tree limbs 15 miles west of Kenedy.
A thunderstorm produced wind gusts estimated at 60 mph.
A thunderstorm produced one inch hail in Falls City.
A thunderstorm produced wind gusts estimated at 60 mph that blew over a grain bin and some yard fixtures near Falls City.
A thunderstorm produced wind gusts estimated at 60 mph that blew down some power lines near Panna Maria.
A thunderstorm produced one inch hail near Cestohowa.
A thunderstorm produced wind gusts estimated at 60 mph that damaged a playscape on Hwy 181 south of Kenedy.
A thunderstorm produced wind gusts measured at 51 kts. by the AWOS at Kenedy Regional Airport.
A thunderstorm produced quarter size hail in Runge. We were sent a picture of the hail.
A thunderstorm produced wind gusts estimated at 90 mph that uprooted trees along FM 99 southwest of Karnes City.
A thunderstorm produced wind gusts measured at 52 kts by the AWOS at Kenedy Regional Airport.
A thunderstorm produced golf ball size hail southwest of Coy City.
A thunderstorm produced wind gust measured at 50 kts by the AWOS at Kenedy Regional Airport.
A thunderstorm produced wind gusts estimated at 60 mph that knocked down a fence and tore some metal roofing off a house in Gillett.
A thunderstorm produced quarter size hail near Runge.
A thunderstorm produced 2.5 inch diameter hail in Falls City.
